authority: The Long Game H5, greenlit 2026-09-29; GDD §16.8's grievance states (Wary, Insulted, Retaliating, Vendetta) with Friendly and Neutral above them. Owner answer 27 (2026-09-30): no corners, so standing moves through choices, doors and fights. Derived from state.relationships; nothing new is saved but a little bookkeeping.

rungs.label: Wary
rungs.effect: Their jobs stop being offered. Their people watch you.

rungs.label: Insulted
rungs.effect: They want restitution, in euros, and they will say so.

rungs.label: Retaliating
rungs.effect: They warn you one night and come for you the next.

rungs.label: Vendetta
rungs.effect: They come for you every night until something changes.
